payload.title: File:North American Caenagnathid Distribution.png
payload.description_html: Map (A) of North America, showing provinces and states from which caenagnathids have been collected (highlighted in yellow), and formations where caenagnathids are known to occur. Names and horizons are provided for caenagnathids for which mandibular material has been found. Abbreviations: 1, Scollard Formation (Maastrichtian); 2, Horseshoe Canyon Formation (Campanian-Maastrichtian), 3, Dinosaur Park Formation (Campanian); 4, Frenchman Formation (Maastrichtian), 5, Hell Creek Formation, Northern Montana (Maastrichtian); 6, Cloverly Formation (Aptian-Albian); 7, Hell Creek Formation, Eastern Montana (Maastrichtian); 8, Hell Creek Formation, North and South Dakota (Maastrichtian); 9, Kaiparowitz Formation (Campanian); 10, Ojo Alamo Formation (Maastrichtian); 11, Aguja Formation (Campanian). Modified from Funston et al. (2019a, b).
